scripts.test:skills: python -c "from skills.compliance_check import ComplianceCheckSkill; from skills.copywriting import CopywritingSkill; from skills.economics import EconomicsSkill; from skills.ideation import IdeationSkill; from skills.product_understanding import ProductUnderstandingSkill; from skills.rules_engine import RulesEngineSkill; from skills.visual_agent import VisualAgentSkill; print('All 7 skills OK')"

scripts.test:economics: python -c "import asyncio; from skills.economics import EconomicsSkill; s = EconomicsSkill(mock=True); r = asyncio.run(s.run(cost_cny=12, weight_kg=0.3, length_cm=20, width_cm=15, height_cm=8)); print(f'Economics test OK: {len(r["platforms"])} platforms')"
